exclusions: Raw W&B service/cache files; raw compiler cache (retained as source/inductor-cache.tar.gz); verification paths and storage.json receipts; Python caches. Manifest excludes its own bytes.
method: Every local scientific file rehashed with SHA256; every remote size and MD5 (or CRC32C for composite objects) checked against local bytes. Manifest downloaded and matched exactly. Checksum-only rsync dry run reported zero changes. Large objects were not individually downloaded.
notes: Scientific manifest excludes itself and retention receipts to avoid self-reference.
Failed attempts and failed numerical screens remain in the scientific inventory.
The compiler cache used by exact midpoint recovery is retained as an archive.
Receipt files are uploaded and independently downloaded after this verification.
